note: Sun 18:00 ET CME reopen came in more measured than feared. ES -0.26%, NQ -0.86% — both well under the 2% escalation threshold. Story arc: (1) Sun 5pm ET CENTCOM launched FOURTH strike wave — 140 targets, heavier than Sat's third round; (2) Iran retaliated across Qatar/UAE/Bahrain/Kuwait/Oman/Jordan overnight — most extensive regional strikes yet; (3) Trump publicly denied Iran controls Hormuz — CENTCOM escorted ~20 vessels through southern route in 24hrs, southern lane operational; (4) SK Hynix plunged in Seoul (-4.4% intraday, hit -10%) on Nasdaq/Kospi decoupling — profit-taking after Fri +13% ADR debut; (5) Kospi actually opened +0.2% to 7,490. Brent touched $80 briefly, held $78.68 +3.51%; WTI $73.89 +3.47%. Gold -1% — the market read this as bounded regional conflict, NOT existential. This is a garden-variety geopolitical event playing out (Sun brief base rate call: Aramco 2019, Israel-Hamas 2023, Iran-Israel 2024 all faded). Real event is CPI + Warsh + banks Tue.

geo_headlines: Sun 17:00 ET: US CENTCOM launched FOURTH round of strikes on Iran (140 targets — much heavier than Sat's third round). Hit missile/drone launch sites, ammunition dumps, communication equipment, radar sites, coastal defenses. Explicitly designed to degrade Iran's anti-shipping capability. First use of one-way attack sea drones (CENTCOM, AP, WSJ, NDTV, CBS)

Iran retaliated Sun evening/Mon early with drone and missile strikes across Qatar, UAE, Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman and Jordan targeting US installations — most extensive regional attacks yet. Qatar: 3 injured incl. child by falling shrapnel. Kuwait: border posts + offshore oil platform hit. UAE air defenses engaged (Reuters/Internazionale, ICIS)

Iran declared Strait of Hormuz CLOSED again Sun 'until further notice, until end of American intervention.' CENTCOM response: 'Iran does not control the strait. Traffic is flowing.' US escorted ~20 vessels through southern route in 24hrs; JMIC confirms southern lane operational (CENTCOM, Reuters, CBS)

Oil futures reopen: WTI $73.97 +3.59%, Brent $78.68 +3.51% (briefly touched $80). Market pricing bounded regional conflict, NOT full closure. Under-5% gap consistent with prior Middle East shocks fading over 5-15 sessions (ICIS, Business Times, Mint, Tribune India, Reuters)

Iran's chief negotiator Qalibaf: 'The era of one-sided deals is OVER. We told you: keep your word or pay the price. Reality is knocking.' Insisted US must first honor Islamabad MOU commitments on Hormuz transit and Iranian oil-export normalization before talks resume (Mint, Reuters, CBS)

OIC condemned Iranian strikes against Qatar/Oman/Kuwait/UAE/Bahrain/Jordan as 'flagrant violation of national sovereignty.' Oman summoned Iranian ambassador for formal protest. Pakistan/Qatar/Egypt continuing indirect mediation. Trump maintained 'ceasefire OVER' but says US open to further talks (Tribune India, AP)

SK Hynix decoupling: Nasdaq ADR (SKHY) closed +13% at $168 Fri; Seoul mother-stock fell as much as 4.4% Mon (some reports -10%). Kospi still up +0.2% on Samsung/SoftBank support. Kioxia plunged alongside. Profit-taking + regional risk-off (Investing.com, Chosun Biz, Straits Times, Tradingkey)

Fed Chair Warsh testifies Tue 10am (House) and Wed 10am (Senate) — first public testimony as chair. Combined with Tue 08:30 CPI + bank kickoff Tue BMO, Tuesday is the entire week. Cons June CPI 3.7-3.8% YoY (from 4.2%), MoM -0.1% (deflation on retreating energy — but weekend oil gap NOT in this print). Cleveland Fed nowcast 3.92% (CMC, IG, Chosun)
